# Disability Persona Toolkit (DPT)

For toolkit work, follow [the resource instructions](../../Disability-Persona-Toolkit/AGENTS.md).
Run toolkit commands from `Disability-Persona-Toolkit`, not the monorepo root.
Use the [persona-to-schema skill](../skills/persona-to-schema/SKILL.md) to generate YAML from
Markdown. These instructions do not apply to `Maximize-All-Windows`.
